description: Bounded parameters for deterministic page feature extraction (babeldoc/magazine/page_features.py). Numeric parameters carry a '<name>_allowed_range' sibling of the form 'low..high', inclusive on both ends. List parameters are closed vocabularies of IL structure values (upstream form types, upstream layout labels); the list is its own bound, so it takes no allowed range. Tuning happens here; the extractor holds no literals of either kind.
